name: Dentium CO., LTD
summary: Dentium CO., LTD manufactures and sells dental medical instrument worldwide. Its implant systems include superline, implantium, implantium 2, N.R. line, simple line 2, and slim line. The company also provides block and coloring; regeneration products; and digital dentistry products. In addition, it offers orthodontics, bright resin, tooth care, and other dental products. The company was formerly known as Biostech Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Dentium Co.,Ltd. in August 2002. Dentium Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
